name: Kantai no Aisatsu Murakumo Hen
original_name: 艦隊の挨拶 叢雲編
source:
Murakumo in her Kai 2 form visits the quarters of hentai admiral.
Since he's a hentai various things happen to her!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ157396.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
村云以Kai 2形态拜访了无尽海军上将的住处。
因为他是一个无尽的人，所以她身上会发生各种各样的事情！

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ157396.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
